description: Paid ($0.50, x402 v2 exact). Checks 1-20 items in one call and returns per-item results and a summary. Invalid batch requests (malformed body, missing or invalid batch idempotency_key, or items other than an array of 1-20 entries) are refused before payment and incur no charge. An invalid item in an otherwise valid paid batch returns INPUT_ERROR as part of the paid result. The batch price still applies. Checks require EVM-format recipient addresses. XNO on nano:mainnet can pay for checks where enabled. A Nano-format recipient returns INPUT_ERROR before payment in a single check, or as an item error in a paid batch. Replay the same request with the same batch idempotency_key to retrieve the stored result without a new payment.
name: check_payment_batch
